_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 3 (B29, D4/§5) — layers an Iron's Spells Arcane Essence onto the Alchemist's Distillery's chest. Inert without Iron's Spells: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent. Gate-safe: arcane essence is the common Iron's crafting mat, never an Upgrade Orb / spellbook / named scroll.
